messages:
nina: FYI docs deploy failed this morning, mkdocs error: KeyError during toc/slugs.

leo: Can you paste the snippet?

nina: pages/guides/migrate-auth.md has a bulleted list with inconsistent indent and trailing spaces:

```
- Configure auth.  
  - set provider
- Restart services
```

ash: That pattern produced an empty anchor token in the TOC slugifier before. Quick fix = remove trailing spaces and align the sublist.

leo: I'll open a tiny PR to fix the file and add a strict mkdocs build step.

docs-bot: @leo opened PR #2521 — "docs: normalize list whitespace and enable mkdocs --strict" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2521

ci-bot: docs CI started for PR #2521 — running mkdocs build --strict

ci-bot: docs CI ✅ build succeeded (mkdocs build --strict) — all checks passed

leo: Merged to main and deployed to staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.example/guides/migrate-auth.html

nina: Verified the TOC and anchor now show correctly.

ash: Filed follow-up issue to add a pre-commit hook for whitespace normalization.

nina: Thanks all, closing thread.
